_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Saraswat Bank Secured RuPay Platinum Credit Card

eligibility_engine.notes: Page: Indian resident, minimum age 18; only against a Saraswat Co-operative Bank term deposit (not against tax-saving deposits or deposits of minors, HUF, companies, trusts, societies and firms); minimum face value INR 6,500 for at least 1 year, all schemes with 12 months auto renewal except Kar Mukti, Short Term and Minor. Credit limit 80% of face value, minimum INR 5,000, maximum INR 25,00,000; cash limit 40% of the card limit.

components: 100% of all pending charges and taxes

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: No annual fee to waive (issuer states nil annual fee).

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: 500 welcome bonus points on card activation and 300 reward points on the 1st successful transaction (page).

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: Issuer Credit Card page: eligibility, schedule of charges for all RuPay credit cards w.e.f. January 2026, rewards line
RuPay Credit Cards MITC booklet, Version 2.3 January 2026 (34 pages, image PDF created 29 Jun 2026)
Issuer Secured Credit Card page: eligibility, FD terms, schedule of charges w.e.f. January 2026
Additional terms and conditions for the Secured RuPay Platinum Credit Card (2 pages, PDF dated Aug 2019): lien on the term deposit, 80% limit

open_questions: Rewards: the page states only "500 Welcome Bonus points on card activation and 300 Reward points on 1st successful transaction" and a "Rewards & Cashbacks" tab with no rate. No earn rate per amount spent, no point value and no expiry is published on the page or in the MITC booklet; the points sit behind a rewards-portal login. No earn rule is written; the card is held until Saraswat publishes one.

Network: stated as RuPay (RuPay Platinum) on the issuer pages, the MITC booklet "RuPay Credit Cards" (v2.3 January 2026) and the Secured MITC; the offers link points to the RuPay Platinum page on rupay.co.in. No other network is mentioned.

Fee schedule is "applicable for all RuPay Credit Cards w.e.f. January 2026" (page). The MITC booklet says the annual fee "may vary for each Cardholder and from offer to offer", so the figures are the page schedule only.
Railway ticket fee 1.8% + GST; fuel surcharge "varies by fuel station and acquirer" (MITC); no fuel waiver is stated.
Welcome points: 500 on activation and 300 on the first successful transaction; the rupee value per point is not stated, so effective_value_inr is null.
Cash payment of the bill: nil up to INR 5,000, INR 125 above (page).
How to apply: "visit your nearest branch" (page); no online application.
Main MITC (34 pages) is a scanned image booklet read with OCR; wording was read from the OCR and the headline fee table from the page.
Annual fee: lifetime free card (page). The additional-terms PDF is dated Aug 2019 (PDF metadata) while the page schedule is w.e.f. January 2026; the schedule on the page is used.

Finance charges 1.25% a month (15% a year); EMI on purchase 1% a month, total outstanding into EMI 1.25% a month; conversion and pre-closure nil. Late payment INR 150; replacement INR 200. Auto debit return fee not applicable.

Secured card terms: term deposit stays in auto-renewal for the life of the card, lien on the deposit excluding interest; deposit liquidated if the minimum due is not paid within 90 days (Secured MITC).
notes: Differs from the unsecured RuPay Platinum card in fees (lifetime free, interest 1.25% a month, late fee INR 150), so it is its own card.
